# vocab random
v=Counter()
lengths=Counter()
for i,mid in rand:
 ws=mid.split(); lengths[len(ws)]+=1; v.update(ws)

# index gaps maybe condition
inds=[i for i,_ in rand]
print(inds[:100])
print('gaps',Counter(b-a for a,b in zip(inds,inds[1:])).most_common(20))

# instrument manually
lines=b[:-1].split(b'\n')
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
 pref=(b'%05d ' % i); suf=(b' %d'%((i*7)%97))

 mid=line[len(pref):len(line)-len(suf)]
 if mid!=compress.TEMPLATES[i%6]:

  for w in words:
   if w not in compress.VMAP: print('vocab fail',i,w,mid); raise SystemExit
else: print('all ok')
enc=compress.try_custom(b); print(enc[:6] if enc else None, len(enc) if enc else None)
